commands.code:
import csv,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()/"benchmark_tools/results"
out=root/"native_qfo_four_cell_strata_integration_20261009_v1"
manifest=json.loads((out/"manifest.json").read_text())
def check(ref):
    p=Path(ref["path"]);d=p.read_bytes()
    assert len(d)==ref["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(d).hexdigest()==ref["sha256"]
for ref in [*manifest["inputs"].values(),manifest["source"],*manifest["outputs"],manifest["manuscript"]]:
    check(ref)
result=json.loads(Path(manifest["inputs"]["result"]["path"]).read_text())
reader=json.loads(Path(manifest["inputs"]["reader"]["path"]).read_text())
assert reader["report"]==manifest["inputs"]["result"]
assert result["schema"]=="native_qfo_four_cell_strata_v2" and reader["schema"]=="native_qfo_four_cell_strata_rational_readback_v2"
assert manifest["table_scale"]==100 and manifest["tsv_scale"]==1 and manifest["new_bootstrap_draws"]==0 and not manifest["new_inference_or_scoring"] and not manifest["publication_ready"]
methods=(out/"methods_section.md").read_text();section=(out/"results_section.md").read_text()
parent=Path(manifest["inputs"]["parent"]["path"]).read_text()
draft=Path(manifest["manuscript"]["path"]).read_text()
assert methods not in parent and section not in parent and draft.count(methods)==draft.count(section)==1
assert draft.replace(methods,"",1).replace(section,"",1)==parent
source=[r for r in result["differences"] if r["contrast"]=="P_at_C0_R1"]
fields=["suite","stratum","families","status","F1","PPV","TPR"]
with (out/"profile_bins.tsv").open() as f:
    parser=csv.DictReader(f,delimiter="\t");text=list(parser)
assert parser.fieldnames==fields and len(text)==len(source)==23
lines=[]
for original,row in zip(source,text):
    assert all(row[k]==str(original[k]) for k in fields[:4])
    for metric in fields[4:]:
        assert row[metric]=="NA" if original[metric] is None else float(row[metric])==original[metric]
    numbers=["NA" if original[m] is None else format(100*original[m],"+.3f") for m in fields[4:]]
    lines.append("| "+" | ".join([original["suite"],original["stratum"],str(original["families"]),*numbers])+" |")
suites={"sequence","domain","duplication","model_distance"}
actual=[line for line in section.splitlines() if line.startswith("| ") and line.split("|")[1].strip() in suites]
assert actual==lines
counts={(r["cell"],r["family"]):r["counts_without_prior"] for r in result["family_rows"]}
changes=[]
for family in sorted(result["memberships"]):
    delta={k:counts["p1_c0_r1",family][k]-counts["p0_c0_r1",family][k] for k in ("TP","FP","FN","TN")}
    if any(delta.values()): changes.append(dict(family=family,**delta))
assert changes==manifest["changed_family_counts"]==[dict(family="CASP",TP=0,FP=-3,FN=0,TN=3),dict(family="GH14",TP=-1,FP=0,FN=1,TN=0)]
for row in changes:
    line="| "+" | ".join([row["family"],*[format(row[k],"+d") for k in ("TP","FP","FN","TN")]])+" |"
    assert section.count(line)==1
for phrase in ("-0.320215","+0.132851","-0.762755","+0.160465","-0.794278","No subgroup intervals were computed","not a general entropy","Five empty bins support no effect"):
    assert phrase in section,phrase
for ref in [*manifest["inputs"].values(),manifest["source"],*manifest["outputs"],manifest["manuscript"]]:
    check(ref)
print(json.dumps(dict(status="independent_profile_strata_manuscript_readback_passed",profile_rows=23,raw_and_human_value_cells=69,count_changes_verified=changes,parent_body_restored_exactly=True,no_integration_helper_imported=True,publication_ready=False)))
